title: Rule chains (single-pass warning, merge / split)
summary: ConvRulesEditor marks #convert chains, cycles, duplicate From types and unit swap chains on Save; offers merge into TA -> TC or split into stage books
intro: convert-apply is single pass, so TA -> TB plus TB -> TC leaves a TA as TB. The editor warns about this on Save and offers one click to merge the rules into TA -> TC or to split the stages into books the Convert tab runs in order.

questions.ask: Why does my TA -> TB plus TB -> TC book leave a TA as TB?
questions.command: ConvRulesEditor.exe > Conversion > Rule chains... (convert-apply is single pass; Merge to TA -> TC or Split into stage books)

questions.ask: How do I run the stage books in the right order?
questions.command: ConvRulesEditor.exe > Conversion > Convert... > check the books in order (Move Up / Move Down)
